meta.title: Edge of Daybreak
meta.description: We drift further and further away as we test the limits of gravity. Until the sweetness fades away, until there is nowhere left to search.

units.rawText: In dark lilac space, the spaceship quietly proceeds along.
units.displayText: In dark lilac space, the spaceship quietly proceeds along.

spans.text: In dark lilac space, the spaceship quietly proceeds along.

units.rawText: Huff... that was unexpectedly easy.
units.displayText: Huff... that was unexpectedly easy.

spans.text: Huff... that was unexpectedly easy.

units.rawText: There weren't many Entropized Agents this time, but they were strong... if Hubble wasn't there, I doubt I would've been able to handle it.
units.displayText: There weren't many Entropized Agents this time, but they were strong... if Hubble wasn't there, I doubt I would've been able to handle it.

spans.text: There weren't many Entropized Agents this time, but they were strong... if Hubble wasn't there, I doubt I would've been able to handle it.

units.rawText: Is it not amusing to erase stardust together?
units.displayText: Is it not amusing to erase stardust together?

spans.text: Is it not amusing to erase stardust together?

units.rawText: I leave the next step of the route planning with Antonina and the autopilot, turning back to the team that had just returned to the spaceship. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, welcoming them with dancing tentacles.
units.displayText: I leave the next step of the route planning with Antonina and the autopilot, turning back to the team that had just returned to the spaceship. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, welcoming them with dancing tentacles.

spans.text: I leave the next step of the route planning with Antonina and the autopilot, turning back to the team that had just returned to the spaceship. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, welcoming them with dancing tentacles.

units.rawText: Good work, you two. Was the memory data this time all related to the Oasis?
units.displayText: Good work, you two. Was the memory data this time all related to the Oasis?

spans.text: Good work, you two. Was the memory data this time all related to the Oasis?

units.rawText: Yes, but it's a little disorganized... there's a lot, but it's not complete, and all in one heap.
units.displayText: Yes, but it's a little disorganized... there's a lot, but it's not complete, and all in one heap.

spans.text: Yes, but it's a little disorganized... there's a lot, but it's not complete, and all in one heap.

units.rawText: There's... Christmas, a birthday... and... some other type of festivity?
units.displayText: There's... Christmas, a birthday... and... some other type of festivity?

spans.text: There's... Christmas, a birthday... and... some other type of festivity?

units.rawText: Ah, no. That seems to be White Valentine...
units.displayText: Ah, no. That seems to be White Valentine...

spans.text: Ah, no. That seems to be White Valentine...

units.rawText: I glance at Hubble's slightly confused countenance and laugh silently.
units.displayText: I glance at Hubble's slightly confused countenance and laugh silently.

spans.text: I glance at Hubble's slightly confused countenance and laugh silently.

units.rawText: Back then, the Oasis only had a tiny little patch of beach.
units.displayText: Back then, the Oasis only had a tiny little patch of beach.

spans.text: Back then, the Oasis only had a tiny little patch of beach.

units.rawText: Beneath sparkling starlight, delicate waves thump down on pillowy sand, ambient light drifting in the air like reflections of the stars.
units.displayText: Beneath sparkling starlight, delicate waves thump down on pillowy sand, ambient light drifting in the air like reflections of the stars.

spans.text: Beneath sparkling starlight, delicate waves thump down on pillowy sand, ambient light drifting in the air like reflections of the stars.

units.rawText: A clear night sky accents the sweetness of chocolate, and a fine time between two people is precious beyond compare. The glittering waves carry the heart's wishes, and the eyes of the one next to me shine like the sea fireflies.
units.displayText: A clear night sky accents the sweetness of chocolate, and a fine time between two people is precious beyond compare. The glittering waves carry the heart's wishes, and the eyes of the one next to me shine like the sea fireflies.

spans.text: A clear night sky accents the sweetness of chocolate, and a fine time between two people is precious beyond compare. The glittering waves carry the heart's wishes, and the eyes of the one next to me shine like the sea fireflies.

units.rawText: Some people call them blue gravel, but their light is so dazzling that the name seems mundane.
units.displayText: Some people call them blue gravel, but their light is so dazzling that the name seems mundane.

spans.text: Some people call them blue gravel, but their light is so dazzling that the name seems mundane.

units.rawText: Some people call them blue tears, but their gleam is so lively that the name seems overly dismal.
units.displayText: Some people call them blue tears, but their gleam is so lively that the name seems overly dismal.

spans.text: Some people call them blue tears, but their gleam is so lively that the name seems overly dismal.

units.rawText: Professor, what do you think they're more like?
units.displayText: Professor, what do you think they're more like?

spans.text: Professor, what do you think they're more like?
Gems.
Stars.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: Memories come flowing back. That misty sensation is still by my side, conveying an ephemeral romance.
units.displayText: Memories come flowing back. That misty sensation is still by my side, conveying an ephemeral romance.

spans.text: Memories come flowing back. That misty sensation is still by my side, conveying an ephemeral romance.

units.rawText: The memories afterward are somewhat blurry and faded, whether it was about her or me.
units.displayText: The memories afterward are somewhat blurry and faded, whether it was about her or me.

spans.text: The memories afterward are somewhat blurry and faded, whether it was about her or me.

units.rawText: Yet those memories are entrenched so deeply, keeping me in front of that ocean, in that exchange.
units.displayText: Yet those memories are entrenched so deeply, keeping me in front of that ocean, in that exchange.

spans.text: Yet those memories are entrenched so deeply, keeping me in front of that ocean, in that exchange.

units.rawText: Professor? What are you looking at?
units.displayText: Professor? What are you looking at?

spans.text: Professor? What are you looking at?

units.rawText: ...The stars.
units.displayText: ...The stars.

spans.text: ...The stars.

units.rawText: Hehe... you still remember things from back then.
units.displayText: Hehe... you still remember things from back then.

spans.text: Hehe... you still remember things from back then.

units.rawText: You only just remembered, no?
units.displayText: You only just remembered, no?

spans.text: You only just remembered, no?

units.rawText: I extend a hand towards Hubble, a delicate starlight chocolate in my hand, the very same she used to give me.
units.displayText: I extend a hand towards Hubble, a delicate starlight chocolate in my hand, the very same she used to give me.

spans.text: I extend a hand towards Hubble, a delicate starlight chocolate in my hand, the very same she used to give me.

units.rawText: I wonder... what will this one taste like?
units.displayText: I wonder... what will this one taste like?

spans.text: I wonder... what will this one taste like?

units.rawText: Taste it yourself when you feel the time is right.
units.displayText: Taste it yourself when you feel the time is right.

spans.text: Taste it yourself when you feel the time is right.

units.rawText: Are you guys playing at some sort of riddle?
units.displayText: Are you guys playing at some sort of riddle?

spans.text: Are you guys playing at some sort of riddle?

units.rawText: ...Or did I miss something while I was in the middle of that battle?
units.displayText: ...Or did I miss something while I was in the middle of that battle?

spans.text: ...Or did I miss something while I was in the middle of that battle?

units.rawText: About that... maybe you'll come to know eventually, Fresnel.
units.displayText: About that... maybe you'll come to know eventually, Fresnel.

spans.text: About that... maybe you'll come to know eventually, Fresnel.

units.rawText: But by your grace, much of the starlight has been accumulated... and I seem to be a little more lucid, too.
units.displayText: But by your grace, much of the starlight has been accumulated... and I seem to be a little more lucid, too.

spans.text: But by your grace, much of the starlight has been accumulated... and I seem to be a little more lucid, too.

units.rawText: I always feel a faint and indistinct headache, but I can't figure out what exactly is wrong...
units.displayText: I always feel a faint and indistinct headache, but I can't figure out what exactly is wrong...

spans.text: I always feel a faint and indistinct headache, but I can't figure out what exactly is wrong...

units.rawText: Maybe it'll get better when this is all over.
units.displayText: Maybe it'll get better when this is all over.

spans.text: Maybe it'll get better when this is all over.

units.rawText: About that, I have my reservations, but it's not like we can spot any problems from the analysis results...
units.displayText: About that, I have my reservations, but it's not like we can spot any problems from the analysis results...

spans.text: About that, I have my reservations, but it's not like we can spot any problems from the analysis results...

units.rawText: The rest might have to wait until you return to the Oasis, and we can run more thorough tests.
units.displayText: The rest might have to wait until you return to the Oasis, and we can run more thorough tests.

spans.text: The rest might have to wait until you return to the Oasis, and we can run more thorough tests.

units.rawText: Return to the Oasis?
units.displayText: Return to the Oasis?

spans.text: Return to the Oasis?

units.rawText: ...Is something wrong?
units.displayText: ...Is something wrong?

spans.text: ...Is something wrong?

units.rawText: Why must you say "return"...
units.displayText: Why must you say "return"...

spans.text: Why must you say "return"...

units.rawText: No, rather, why should I go to the Oasis?
units.displayText: No, rather, why should I go to the Oasis?

spans.text: No, rather, why should I go to the Oasis?

units.rawText: Hubble. Do you... not intend to return to the Oasis with us when everything's been resolved!?
units.displayText: Hubble. Do you... not intend to return to the Oasis with us when everything's been resolved!?

spans.text: Hubble. Do you... not intend to return to the Oasis with us when everything's been resolved!?

units.rawText: To answer that...
units.displayText: To answer that...

spans.text: To answer that...

units.rawText: I am a lone star, remaining at a distance. I need not feel the call of the cluster.
units.displayText: I am a lone star, remaining at a distance. I need not feel the call of the cluster.

spans.text: I am a lone star, remaining at a distance. I need not feel the call of the cluster.

units.rawText: "To stay at the Oasis"—why should I do this?
units.displayText: "To stay at the Oasis"—why should I do this?

spans.text: "To stay at the Oasis"—why should I do this?

units.rawText: Have I... said anything that might lead to a misunderstanding?
units.displayText: Have I... said anything that might lead to a misunderstanding?

spans.text: Have I... said anything that might lead to a misunderstanding?

units.rawText: Hubble tilts her head slightly, a perfectly tuned expression of confusion on her face. It genuinely conveys a sense of bewilderment, yet betrays a sense of nonchalance, as if...
units.displayText: Hubble tilts her head slightly, a perfectly tuned expression of confusion on her face. It genuinely conveys a sense of bewilderment, yet betrays a sense of nonchalance, as if...

spans.text: Hubble tilts her head slightly, a perfectly tuned expression of confusion on her face. It genuinely conveys a sense of bewilderment, yet betrays a sense of nonchalance, as if...

units.rawText: She had been waiting for us to unearth this question.
units.displayText: She had been waiting for us to unearth this question.

spans.text: She had been waiting for us to unearth this question.

units.rawText: ...Since Hubble isn't prepared yet, let's overlook this topic for now.
units.displayText: ...Since Hubble isn't prepared yet, let's overlook this topic for now.

spans.text: ...Since Hubble isn't prepared yet, let's overlook this topic for now.

units.rawText: Hubble promised that she would contemplate our emotions well. I believe in her.
units.displayText: Hubble promised that she would contemplate our emotions well. I believe in her.

spans.text: Hubble promised that she would contemplate our emotions well. I believe in her.

units.rawText: Hehe... stars do not lie and speak in riddles. I shall observe as well as I can.
units.displayText: Hehe... stars do not lie and speak in riddles. I shall observe as well as I can.

spans.text: Hehe... stars do not lie and speak in riddles. I shall observe as well as I can.

units.rawText: We await your change of mind.
units.displayText: We await your change of mind.

spans.text: We await your change of mind.

units.rawText: Then, let's solve the immediate problems we can. I say we return our attention to our incomplete journey.
units.displayText: Then, let's solve the immediate problems we can. I say we return our attention to our incomplete journey.

spans.text: Then, let's solve the immediate problems we can. I say we return our attention to our incomplete journey.

units.rawText: Xuannu, aren't we approaching this Starsphere's borders?
units.displayText: Xuannu, aren't we approaching this Starsphere's borders?

spans.text: Xuannu, aren't we approaching this Starsphere's borders?

units.rawText: To be exact, we're on the brink of the solar wind's outer regions. Any further, we would enter the region where solar wind interacts with the interstellar medium.
units.displayText: To be exact, we're on the brink of the solar wind's outer regions. Any further, we would enter the region where solar wind interacts with the interstellar medium.

spans.text: To be exact, we're on the brink of the solar wind's outer regions. Any further, we would enter the region where solar wind interacts with the interstellar medium.

units.rawText: Celestial bodies here do not follow common rules, but as we detected before, basic rules still apply.
units.displayText: Celestial bodies here do not follow common rules, but as we detected before, basic rules still apply.

spans.text: Celestial bodies here do not follow common rules, but as we detected before, basic rules still apply.

units.rawText: Ever since you left the Solar System, the effects of gravity have become more difficult to calculate, and the environment has become more dangerous.
units.displayText: Ever since you left the Solar System, the effects of gravity have become more difficult to calculate, and the environment has become more dangerous.

spans.text: Ever since you left the Solar System, the effects of gravity have become more difficult to calculate, and the environment has become more dangerous.

units.rawText: Professor, I'd advise you to manually pilot as much as possible.
units.displayText: Professor, I'd advise you to manually pilot as much as possible.

spans.text: Professor, I'd advise you to manually pilot as much as possible.

units.rawText: No problem. How far are we from our next target?
units.displayText: No problem. How far are we from our next target?

spans.text: No problem. How far are we from our next target?

units.rawText: Almost there... some planets are constantly in motion and aren't easy to track.
units.displayText: Almost there... some planets are constantly in motion and aren't easy to track.

spans.text: Almost there... some planets are constantly in motion and aren't easy to track.

units.rawText: The autopilot system continues to function. Seeing a troubled look in Antonina's eyes, I look downwards at the star chart.
units.displayText: The autopilot system continues to function. Seeing a troubled look in Antonina's eyes, I look downwards at the star chart.

spans.text: The autopilot system continues to function. Seeing a troubled look in Antonina's eyes, I look downwards at the star chart.

units.rawText: In descending order of completeness, the highest priority destination is... another planet we've never seen before.
units.displayText: In descending order of completeness, the highest priority destination is... another planet we've never seen before.

spans.text: In descending order of completeness, the highest priority destination is... another planet we've never seen before.

units.rawText: To be exact, we've never seen any of the planets or bodies here before, including that weird sun & moon pair.
units.displayText: To be exact, we've never seen any of the planets or bodies here before, including that weird sun & moon pair.

spans.text: To be exact, we've never seen any of the planets or bodies here before, including that weird sun & moon pair.

units.rawText: Sure, but we need to speed up. The Starsphere's still changing... is it because of Hubble?
units.displayText: Sure, but we need to speed up. The Starsphere's still changing... is it because of Hubble?

spans.text: Sure, but we need to speed up. The Starsphere's still changing... is it because of Hubble?

units.rawText: Because of... me?
units.displayText: Because of... me?

spans.text: Because of... me?

units.rawText: We've not been able to recover your Entropic Core, but we can still monitor this Starsphere's overall state.
units.displayText: We've not been able to recover your Entropic Core, but we can still monitor this Starsphere's overall state.

spans.text: We've not been able to recover your Entropic Core, but we can still monitor this Starsphere's overall state.

units.rawText: An uptick in Entropization Phenomena is most likely related to your data recovery progress...
units.displayText: An uptick in Entropization Phenomena is most likely related to your data recovery progress...

spans.text: An uptick in Entropization Phenomena is most likely related to your data recovery progress...

units.rawText: If we can analyze your Entropic Core, chances are that we'll be able to figure out how to solve these problems.
units.displayText: If we can analyze your Entropic Core, chances are that we'll be able to figure out how to solve these problems.

spans.text: If we can analyze your Entropic Core, chances are that we'll be able to figure out how to solve these problems.

units.rawText: ...And then do we figure out how to make this dream disappear?
units.displayText: ...And then do we figure out how to make this dream disappear?

spans.text: ...And then do we figure out how to make this dream disappear?

units.rawText: Faced with Hubble's sudden questioning, Antonina takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Faced with Hubble's sudden questioning, Antonina takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Faced with Hubble's sudden questioning, Antonina takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: And then, I'll have to figure out how to take you back.
units.displayText: And then, I'll have to figure out how to take you back.

spans.text: And then, I'll have to figure out how to take you back.

units.rawText: Hehe... don't give me that expression.
units.displayText: Hehe... don't give me that expression.

spans.text: Hehe... don't give me that expression.

units.rawText: As the group converses, the spaceship arrives at its new destination. The Starsphere is not a very large area, and we are at its very edges, beyond the solar wind's reaches.
units.displayText: As the group converses, the spaceship arrives at its new destination. The Starsphere is not a very large area, and we are at its very edges, beyond the solar wind's reaches.

spans.text: As the group converses, the spaceship arrives at its new destination. The Starsphere is not a very large area, and we are at its very edges, beyond the solar wind's reaches.

units.rawText: Professor, the target's right up ahead. We're here.
units.displayText: Professor, the target's right up ahead. We're here.

spans.text: Professor, the target's right up ahead. We're here.

units.rawText: This place is a quiet one, with few traces of Entropization. The memory data on its surface gives off a weak light.
units.displayText: This place is a quiet one, with few traces of Entropization. The memory data on its surface gives off a weak light.

spans.text: This place is a quiet one, with few traces of Entropization. The memory data on its surface gives off a weak light.

units.rawText: Seeing as the so-called sun's influence is almost nonexistent, the influence this body receives is more derived from other nearby bodies. A dark red planet ambles about not far away, administering a weak pull on this body.
units.displayText: Seeing as the so-called sun's influence is almost nonexistent, the influence this body receives is more derived from other nearby bodies. A dark red planet ambles about not far away, administering a weak pull on this body.

spans.text: Seeing as the so-called sun's influence is almost nonexistent, the influence this body receives is more derived from other nearby bodies. A dark red planet ambles about not far away, administering a weak pull on this body.

units.rawText: This place's structure isn't too stable, and might crumble at any moment.
units.displayText: This place's structure isn't too stable, and might crumble at any moment.

spans.text: This place's structure isn't too stable, and might crumble at any moment.

units.rawText: Let's make this quick and easy. I fear that the data on this planet might go with it.
units.displayText: Let's make this quick and easy. I fear that the data on this planet might go with it.

spans.text: Let's make this quick and easy. I fear that the data on this planet might go with it.

units.rawText: Let's go, Hubble!
units.displayText: Let's go, Hubble!

spans.text: Let's go, Hubble!

units.rawText: Back amongst the stars, then—
units.displayText: Back amongst the stars, then—

spans.text: Back amongst the stars, then—

units.rawText: Hubble and Fresnel sequentially step out of the spaceship, their garments flutter in space's eternal twilight, cloaking their descent with starlight. With no air resistance in space, this scene is illogical indeed, yet so mesmerizingly beautiful that one struggles to remove their eyes.
units.displayText: Hubble and Fresnel sequentially step out of the spaceship, their garments flutter in space's eternal twilight, cloaking their descent with starlight. With no air resistance in space, this scene is illogical indeed, yet so mesmerizingly beautiful that one struggles to remove their eyes.

units.rawText: The gap between the two planets slowly closes, and the influence of gravity gradually amplifies.
units.displayText: The gap between the two planets slowly closes, and the influence of gravity gradually amplifies.

spans.text: The gap between the two planets slowly closes, and the influence of gravity gradually amplifies.

units.rawText: I've made contact with this memory segment... huh, when was this?
units.displayText: I've made contact with this memory segment... huh, when was this?

spans.text: I've made contact with this memory segment... huh, when was this?

units.rawText: You don't remember either? I'd say it's roughly...
units.displayText: You don't remember either? I'd say it's roughly...

spans.text: You don't remember either? I'd say it's roughly...

units.rawText: Ah, the latter part's already been polluted with Entropy! It probably ended up here by accident after being polluted.
units.displayText: Ah, the latter part's already been polluted with Entropy! It probably ended up here by accident after being polluted.

spans.text: Ah, the latter part's already been polluted with Entropy! It probably ended up here by accident after being polluted.

units.rawText: Let's move before the data's not fully Entropized!
units.displayText: Let's move before the data's not fully Entropized!

spans.text: Let's move before the data's not fully Entropized!

units.rawText: Hehe, what's wrong with Entropization? It matters not.
units.displayText: Hehe, what's wrong with Entropization? It matters not.

spans.text: Hehe, what's wrong with Entropization? It matters not.

units.rawText: Are these experiences wandering through this dream not exquisite memories, too?
units.displayText: Are these experiences wandering through this dream not exquisite memories, too?

spans.text: Are these experiences wandering through this dream not exquisite memories, too?

units.rawText: That's different, Hubble. If you—
units.displayText: That's different, Hubble. If you—

spans.text: That's different, Hubble. If you—

units.rawText: Fresnel walks towards Hubble with uncertainty on her mind as the pebbles beneath her feet clink together lightly. The sound of crumbling arises, like crushing gravel underfoot on Earth.
units.displayText: Fresnel walks towards Hubble with uncertainty on her mind as the pebbles beneath her feet clink together lightly. The sound of crumbling arises, like crushing gravel underfoot on Earth.

spans.text: Fresnel walks towards Hubble with uncertainty on her mind as the pebbles beneath her feet clink together lightly. The sound of crumbling arises, like crushing gravel underfoot on Earth.

units.rawText: And this planet—does not have sufficient mass to lead Fresnel to crush that pebble!
units.displayText: And this planet—does not have sufficient mass to lead Fresnel to crush that pebble!

spans.text: And this planet—does not have sufficient mass to lead Fresnel to crush that pebble!

units.rawText: A muffled thud comes from deep inside the planet. In the very same moment, I hear a series of shrill warning sounds from the monitoring panel through the comms call. On the other side of the planet, the red planet rapidly closes in, and the conflux of gravity almost tears apart the planet beneath them.
units.displayText: A muffled thud comes from deep inside the planet. In the very same moment, I hear a series of shrill warning sounds from the monitoring panel through the comms call. units.rawText: Fresnel! Hubble!
units.displayText: Fresnel! Hubble!

spans.text: Fresnel! Hubble!

units.rawText: The red planet exerts its gravity on the spaceship as well. I raised the thrusters to maximum capacity in the opposite direction, resisting the sudden pull and keeping the ship aligned with them.
units.displayText: The red planet exerts its gravity on the spaceship as well. I raised the thrusters to maximum capacity in the opposite direction, resisting the sudden pull and keeping the ship aligned with them.

spans.text: The red planet exerts its gravity on the spaceship as well. I raised the thrusters to maximum capacity in the opposite direction, resisting the sudden pull and keeping the ship aligned with them.

units.rawText: Back to the spaceship! Quick!
units.displayText: Back to the spaceship! Quick!

spans.text: Back to the spaceship! Quick!

units.rawText: I... can't get leverage!
units.displayText: I... can't get leverage!

spans.text: I... can't get leverage!

units.rawText: The gravity rapidly magnifies, and the rocks beneath Fresnel's feet begin to disintegrate, almost tripping her over. She dashes towards Hubble with all the effort she can muster, extending a hand. It is but an inch away from grasping a piece of Hubble's garments, yet falls empty.

units.rawText: Hubble... Hubble!
units.displayText: Hubble... Hubble!

spans.text: Hubble... Hubble!

units.rawText: As the data retrieval completes, Hubble slowly raises her head, still immersed in the scattered memories. Her sightline traverses between the fragmented pieces of earth sailing towards the red planet, catching the figure being drawn away by gravity.
units.displayText: As the data retrieval completes, Hubble slowly raises her head, still immersed in the scattered memories. Her sightline traverses between the fragmented pieces of earth sailing towards the red planet, catching the figure being drawn away by gravity.

spans.text: As the data retrieval completes, Hubble slowly raises her head, still immersed in the scattered memories. Her sightline traverses between the fragmented pieces of earth sailing towards the red planet, catching the figure being drawn away by gravity.

units.rawText: No... don't go.
units.displayText: No... don't go.

spans.text: No... don't go.

units.rawText: Don't leave me...
units.displayText: Don't leave me...

spans.text: Don't leave me...

units.rawText: Her absent-minded countenance suddenly awakens. Almost subconsciously, Hubble extends her arms, pushing the encroaching red planet away through the air—
units.displayText: Her absent-minded countenance suddenly awakens. Almost subconsciously, Hubble extends her arms, pushing the encroaching red planet away through the air—

spans.text: Her absent-minded countenance suddenly awakens. Almost subconsciously, Hubble extends her arms, pushing the encroaching red planet away through the air—

units.rawText: A simple, floaty gesture, but one that carries immeasurable weight. The speed at which the distance between the two planets closes slows, then stops. In the very next moment, the red planet's trajectory abruptly changes.
units.displayText: A simple, floaty gesture, but one that carries immeasurable weight. The speed at which the distance between the two planets closes slows, then stops. In the very next moment, the red planet's trajectory abruptly changes.

spans.text: A simple, floaty gesture, but one that carries immeasurable weight. The speed at which the distance between the two planets closes slows, then stops. In the very next moment, the red planet's trajectory abruptly changes.

units.rawText: Get... away from her!
units.displayText: Get... away from her!

spans.text: Get... away from her!

units.rawText: Hubble motions, and the universe turns as she desires.
units.displayText: Hubble motions, and the universe turns as she desires.

spans.text: Hubble motions, and the universe turns as she desires.

units.rawText: With the crisis of gravitational rupture now on hold, the planet beneath their feet stops on the boundary of destruction. Fresnel no longer consigned to that gravitational pull, Hubble steps up, taking her friend's extended hand.
units.displayText: With the crisis of gravitational rupture now on hold, the planet beneath their feet stops on the boundary of destruction. Fresnel no longer consigned to that gravitational pull, Hubble steps up, taking her friend's extended hand.

spans.text: With the crisis of gravitational rupture now on hold, the planet beneath their feet stops on the boundary of destruction. Fresnel no longer consigned to that gravitational pull, Hubble steps up, taking her friend's extended hand.

units.rawText: ...Thank goodness, you're alright.
units.displayText: ...Thank goodness, you're alright.

spans.text: ...Thank goodness, you're alright.

units.rawText: I'm fine... thank you, Hubble.
units.displayText: I'm fine... thank you, Hubble.

spans.text: I'm fine... thank you, Hubble.

units.rawText: Fresnel stares at Hubble's not-often-seen worried countenance in a daze until Antonina's voice comes through the comms.
units.displayText: Fresnel stares at Hubble's not-often-seen worried countenance in a daze until Antonina's voice comes through the comms.

spans.text: Fresnel stares at Hubble's not-often-seen worried countenance in a daze until Antonina's voice comes through the comms.

units.rawText: Don't just stand around—the planet you're standing on might still disintegrate into a million pieces at any time!
units.displayText: Don't just stand around—the planet you're standing on might still disintegrate into a million pieces at any time!

spans.text: Don't just stand around—the planet you're standing on might still disintegrate into a million pieces at any time!

units.rawText: Professor, fire the spaceship's tethers!
units.displayText: Professor, fire the spaceship's tethers!

spans.text: Professor, fire the spaceship's tethers!

units.rawText: I activate the spaceship's support systems, firing a high-strength tow rope that embeds itself by Fresnel and Hubble's feet. Fresnel grabs onto the tether, finally smiling with relief, a great load off their shoulders.
units.displayText: I activate the spaceship's support systems, firing a high-strength tow rope that embeds itself by Fresnel and Hubble's feet. Fresnel grabs onto the tether, finally smiling with relief, a great load off their shoulders.

spans.text: I activate the spaceship's support systems, firing a high-strength tow rope that embeds itself by Fresnel and Hubble's feet. Fresnel grabs onto the tether, finally smiling with relief, a great load off their shoulders.

units.rawText: In the immenseness of space, the dark red planet drifts into the distance, leaving only gases, stardust, and a malevolent aura.
units.displayText: In the immenseness of space, the dark red planet drifts into the distance, leaving only gases, stardust, and a malevolent aura.

spans.text: In the immenseness of space, the dark red planet drifts into the distance, leaving only gases, stardust, and a malevolent aura.

units.rawText: That was dangerous, Fresnel.
units.displayText: That was dangerous, Fresnel.

spans.text: That was dangerous, Fresnel.

units.rawText: You would have been like stardust, lost in the greatness of space. Not even I would be able to find you.
units.displayText: You would have been like stardust, lost in the greatness of space. Not even I would be able to find you.

spans.text: You would have been like stardust, lost in the greatness of space. Not even I would be able to find you.

units.rawText: Hehe... were you worried about me, Hubble?
units.displayText: Hehe... were you worried about me, Hubble?

spans.text: Hehe... were you worried about me, Hubble?

units.rawText: You... are happy? Why?
units.displayText: You... are happy? Why?

spans.text: You... are happy? Why?

units.rawText: I just think that... I haven't seen an expression like that on you in so long.
units.displayText: I just think that... I haven't seen an expression like that on you in so long.

spans.text: I just think that... I haven't seen an expression like that on you in so long.

units.rawText: To have you be upset for my sake... makes me very, very happy.
units.displayText: To have you be upset for my sake... makes me very, very happy.

spans.text: To have you be upset for my sake... makes me very, very happy.

units.rawText: How mystifying... but I can't say I dislike it.
units.displayText: How mystifying... but I can't say I dislike it.

spans.text: How mystifying... but I can't say I dislike it.

units.rawText: I think I am gradually understanding what makes you wish to stay with me so...
units.displayText: I think I am gradually understanding what makes you wish to stay with me so...

spans.text: I think I am gradually understanding what makes you wish to stay with me so...

units.rawText: Then... are you going to go back with us?
units.displayText: Then... are you going to go back with us?

spans.text: Then... are you going to go back with us?

units.rawText: Let me think on it... perhaps there may be other orbits we can yet choose.
units.displayText: Let me think on it... perhaps there may be other orbits we can yet choose.

spans.text: Let me think on it... perhaps there may be other orbits we can yet choose.

units.rawText: Rather, don't you still have an assignment from Xuannu?
units.displayText: Rather, don't you still have an assignment from Xuannu?

spans.text: Rather, don't you still have an assignment from Xuannu?

units.rawText: Hubble deftly redirects the conversation.
units.displayText: Hubble deftly redirects the conversation.

spans.text: Hubble deftly redirects the conversation.

units.rawText: I open the spaceship's cabin door, allowing the miniature Entropic to welcome them and communicate with Xuannu, as Hubble mentioned. In the list of lost agents she provided, one serial code after another is crossed out.
units.displayText: I open the spaceship's cabin door, allowing the miniature Entropic to welcome them and communicate with Xuannu, as Hubble mentioned. In the list of lost agents she provided, one serial code after another is crossed out.

spans.text: I open the spaceship's cabin door, allowing the miniature Entropic to welcome them and communicate with Xuannu, as Hubble mentioned. In the list of lost agents she provided, one serial code after another is crossed out.

units.rawText: The last... and the most important one. However, we've never been able to get a steady signal that we can use to locate it.
units.displayText: The last... and the most important one. However, we've never been able to get a steady signal that we can use to locate it.

spans.text: The last... and the most important one. However, we've never been able to get a steady signal that we can use to locate it.

units.rawText: Just like the previous destination, things in this Starsphere tend to simply move freely.
units.displayText: Just like the previous destination, things in this Starsphere tend to simply move freely.

spans.text: Just like the previous destination, things in this Starsphere tend to simply move freely.

units.rawText: This name is...
units.displayText: This name is...

spans.text: This name is...

units.rawText: The sound of footsteps approaches behind me. Fresnel comes up to the control panel with Hubble, and immediately recognizes the last name on the list.
units.displayText: The sound of footsteps approaches behind me. Fresnel comes up to the control panel with Hubble, and immediately recognizes the last name on the list.

spans.text: The sound of footsteps approaches behind me. Fresnel comes up to the control panel with Hubble, and immediately recognizes the last name on the list.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Gagarin!?</color>
units.displayText: Gagarin!?

spans.text: Gagarin!?

units.rawText: Is that the Agent you mentioned?
units.displayText: Is that the Agent you mentioned?

spans.text: Is that the Agent you mentioned?

units.rawText: Yes, originally sacrificed in the Jupiter region, one of our... most important friends.
units.displayText: Yes, originally sacrificed in the Jupiter region, one of our... most important friends.

spans.text: Yes, originally sacrificed in the Jupiter region, one of our... most important friends.

units.rawText: It was thanks to its defenses that we finally realized the nature of the inside-out Entropization.
units.displayText: It was thanks to its defenses that we finally realized the nature of the inside-out Entropization.

spans.text: It was thanks to its defenses that we finally realized the nature of the inside-out Entropization.

units.rawText: Hubble, do you remember it?
units.displayText: Hubble, do you remember it?

spans.text: Hubble, do you remember it?

units.rawText: Hmm... I have something of an impression, but... there aren't many memories left.
units.displayText: Hmm... I have something of an impression, but... there aren't many memories left.

spans.text: Hmm... I have something of an impression, but... there aren't many memories left.

units.rawText: Is this the next piece of star-crumb that needs to be removed?
units.displayText: Is this the next piece of star-crumb that needs to be removed?

spans.text: Is this the next piece of star-crumb that needs to be removed?

units.rawText: A crumb? ...No, this one's different from the other Entropics. This one used to be our friend.
units.displayText: A crumb? ...No, this one's different from the other Entropics. This one used to be our friend.

spans.text: A crumb? ...No, this one's different from the other Entropics. This one used to be our friend.

units.rawText: Is that so? But... I fail to see the difference...
units.displayText: Is that so? But... I fail to see the difference...

spans.text: Is that so? But... I fail to see the difference...

units.rawText: If "Gagarin" is nothing like the scrap, why eliminate it instead of allowing it to return to you?
units.displayText: If "Gagarin" is nothing like the scrap, why eliminate it instead of allowing it to return to you?

spans.text: If "Gagarin" is nothing like the scrap, why eliminate it instead of allowing it to return to you?

units.rawText: To return to Jiutian in the form of an Entropic is like what I am to the Oasis.
units.displayText: To return to Jiutian in the form of an Entropic is like what I am to the Oasis.

spans.text: To return to Jiutian in the form of an Entropic is like what I am to the Oasis.

units.rawText: ...That's different, Hubble. Gagarin had its own responsibilities, and was born for Jiutian.
units.displayText: ...That's different, Hubble. Gagarin had its own responsibilities, and was born for Jiutian.

spans.text: ...That's different, Hubble. Gagarin had its own responsibilities, and was born for Jiutian.

units.rawText: If a fully Entropized Agent is allowed to remain in Jiutian, it will become a hidden hazard. We cannot allow this.
units.displayText: If a fully Entropized Agent is allowed to remain in Jiutian, it will become a hidden hazard. We cannot allow this.

spans.text: If a fully Entropized Agent is allowed to remain in Jiutian, it will become a hidden hazard. We cannot allow this.

units.rawText: Hidden hazard?
units.displayText: Hidden hazard?

spans.text: Hidden hazard?

units.rawText: Hubble mulls over the words, turning towards me.
units.displayText: Hubble mulls over the words, turning towards me.

spans.text: Hubble mulls over the words, turning towards me.

units.rawText: I know, Professor, that you, Fresnel, Antonina... all want to try and take me back to the Oasis.
units.displayText: I know, Professor, that you, Fresnel, Antonina... all want to try and take me back to the Oasis.

spans.text: I know, Professor, that you, Fresnel, Antonina... all want to try and take me back to the Oasis.

units.rawText: But an Entropic I remain.
units.displayText: But an Entropic I remain.

spans.text: But an Entropic I remain.

units.rawText: If I would become a hidden hazard to the Oasis too... Professor, what would you consign me to then?
units.displayText: If I would become a hidden hazard to the Oasis too... Professor, what would you consign me to then?

spans.text: If I would become a hidden hazard to the Oasis too... Professor, what would you consign me to then?

units.rawText: After numerous little adventures chasing down memories, Hubble and Fresnel find themselves back inside the spaceship once more.
units.displayText: After numerous little adventures chasing down memories, Hubble and Fresnel find themselves back inside the spaceship once more.

spans.text: After numerous little adventures chasing down memories, Hubble and Fresnel find themselves back inside the spaceship once more.

units.rawText: Professor, we're back.
units.displayText: Professor, we're back.

spans.text: Professor, we're back.
